Rashi on Chullin 84a:10:1.hebrew: לסימנין - שאין סימני חיה מפורשת, אלא בבהמה כתיב (דברים יד): "כל בהמה מפרסת פרסה וגו'":
Rashi on Chullin 84a:10:1.english: With regard to [its] characteristics - For the characteristics of an undomesticated animal are not explicitly stated [in the Torah]; rather, it is written regarding a domesticated animal (Deuteronomy 14): "Every [domesticated] animal that has a split hoof, etc.":

Rashi on Chullin 84a:10:2.english: I will also say [that] a domesticated animal is included in [the category of] an undomesticated animal with regard to covering [the blood] - For we derive in [the chapter] Behemah HaMakshah (above, Chullin 70b) that a domesticated animal is also included in [the category of] an undomesticated animal:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:12:1.english: If that is so, let one immerse [impure items] in it - since it is called water:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:12:2.hebrew: אך מעין ובור - בפרשת שרצים כתיב, דמשמע אך מעין ובור יטהר את מי שנטמא בשרצים:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:12:2.english: But a spring or a cistern - [This] is written in the section concerning creeping creatures, which implies [that] "but a spring or a cistern" will purify one who became impure through creeping creatures:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:13:1.hebrew: אבל דם דאקרי מים ה"נ - דמטבילין:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:13:1.english: But [with regard to] blood, which is called water, [it is] indeed [so] - [meaning] that one may immerse [in it]:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:15:1.hebrew: זוחלין - שאר משקין שנתנן במקום מדרון והזחילן למקוה, דאילו גבי מים קי"ל בתמורה בפ"ק (דף יב:): השאיבה מטהרת ברבייה והמשכה — אם רבו מי גשמים עד כ"א סאין, ממשיך לתוכן שאובין בזחילה י"ט סאין:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:15:1.english: Flowing - other liquids that one placed on a slope and caused to flow into a ritual bath; whereas regarding water, we hold in Temurah in the first chapter (12b): Drawn [water] purifies through majority and channeling — if rainwater is the majority, [reaching] twenty-one se'ah, one may channel nineteen se'ah of drawn [water] into it by flowing:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:16:1.english: Three exclusions - for [the word] "water" applies to all of them:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:16:2.hebrew: מעין מים - ולא שאר משקין, ואפילו זוחלים:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:16:2.english: A spring of water - and not other liquids, even flowing [ones]:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:16:3.english: A cistern of water - and not other liquids, even gathered [ones]:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:16:4.english: A gathering of water - and not blood:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:18:1.hebrew: אלא בהזמנה הזאת - כאילו הוא צד, שאינה מזומנת לו, כלומר: לא יאכל בשר תדיר, שלא יעני:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:18:1.english: Only with this preparation - As if he traps [it], for it is not readily available to him; that is to say, one should not eat meat constantly, lest he become impoverished:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:1:1.hebrew: וליפרקינהו - ויהיו מותרים באכילה, והדר ליכסייה לדם:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:1:1.english: And let one redeem them - and they will be permitted for eating, and then let him cover the blood:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:1:2.hebrew: בעינן העמדה והערכה - אין פודין את הקדשים לאחר מיתה, מפני שכתוב בהן (ויקרא כז): "והעמיד את הבהמה לפני הכהן (והרים) [והעריך] אותה הכהן", ולאחר מיתה אינה יכולה לעמוד:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:1:2.english: We require setting and valuating - One does not redeem consecrated animals after death, because it is written regarding them (Leviticus 27): "And he shall set the animal before the priest, and the priest shall valuate it," and after death it cannot stand:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:20:1.hebrew: מבקרך - אם יש לו בעדרו יקח, ואם לאו לא יקנה בשוק:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:20:1.english: Of your cattle - If he has [animals] in his herd, he may take [them], and if not, he should not buy [meat] in the market:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:20:2.hebrew: כל בקרו - אם אין לו אלא שור אחד, יזבחנו:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:20:2.english: All of his cattle - If he has only one ox, [one might have thought] he may slaughter it.

Rashi on Chullin 84a:21:1.english: For his stewpot [lefaso] - For his pot. [It is] from the term ilpas [stewpot].

Rashi on Chullin 84a:21:2.english: The weight of a litra of vegetables - but he should not eat meat. Fish were cheaper in their place than meat:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:21:3.hebrew: ישפות - כשנותנין קדרה על הכירה, קרי שפיתה:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:21:3.english: He shall place [a pot] - When one places a pot on the stove, it is called shefitah [setting on the fire]:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:21:4.hebrew: ואינך אימת - אלו האחרים שאמרו ליטרא דגים וליטרא בשר, אימת יאכלוה אם לא בכל יום:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:21:4.english: And these, when - These others [regarding whom] they stated a litra of fish and a litra of meat — when shall they eat it, if not every day?

Rashi on Chullin 84a:22:1.english: To be concerned - and to make do with simple foods:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:22:2.english: Abba [was] from a family of healthy [people] - Rabbi Yochanan calls Rav "Abba":

Rashi on Chullin 84a:22:3.english: Such as us - [meaning] that we are not healthy:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:22:4.hebrew: מי שאין לו אלא פרוטה יריצנה לחנוני - ולא יסגף עצמו בעינוי, ויצטרך לבריות יותר:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:22:4.english: One who has only a perutah should hasten it to the storekeeper - and should not afflict himself with deprivation, and [thereby] become even more dependent on [other] people:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:22:5.hebrew: אמר רב נחמן כגון אנו - רב נחמן אחר דורו של ר' יוחנן היה, ותמיד העולם היה משתנה והולך, ולא היה בריא כאותן שבימי רבי יוחנן; ולפיכך הוא אומר "כגון אנו", דאפילו אין לנו הפרוטה, עלינו ללוות ולאכול:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:22:5.english: Rav Nachman said: Such as us - Rav Nachman was after the generation of Rabbi Yochanan, and the world was constantly changing [for the worse] and was not [as] healthy as those [who lived] in the days of Rabbi Yochanan; therefore he says, "Such as us," [meaning] that even if we do not have the perutah, we must borrow and eat:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:23:1.english: Lambs [will be] for your clothing - It is a verse in the Book of Proverbs. [Meaning:] Buy yourself sheep, and you will have the shearings for clothing:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:23:2.english: And purchase goats - [i.e.,] flock from which he has milk for sustenance and shearings for clothing:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:23:3.hebrew: דיו לאדם - הכי משמע: "די חלב עזים" — די לך בחלבם, ולא תשחטם ותאכלם:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:23:3.english: It is sufficient for a person - This is what [the verse] means: "Goats’ milk enough" — their milk is sufficient for you, and you should not slaughter them and eat them.

Rashi on Chullin 84a:24:1.hebrew: תן חיים לנערותיך - לבני ביתך, למד דרכי חיים, להסתפק במזונות קלים:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:24:1.english: Give life to your maidens - to the members of your household; teach [them] ways of life, to make do with light foods:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:2:1.hebrew: וכמאן - מוקמת למתניתין, דתרצת לה בהני תרי טעמי: שחיטה שאינה ראויה לאו שחיטה היא, ובעינן העמדה והערכה:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:2:1.english: And in accordance with whom - do you establish the Mishnah, that you resolved it with these two reasons: [that] slaughter that is not fit [to permit the meat] is not [considered] slaughter, and [that] we require setting and valuating:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:2:2.hebrew: אי כר"מ דאמר - בפ"ב דתמורה (דף לב: ע"ש):
Rashi on Chullin 84a:2:2.english: If [the Mishnah is] in accordance with Rabbi Meir, who says - [this is] in the second chapter of [Tractate] Temurah (32b; see there):

Rashi on Chullin 84a:2:3.hebrew: הכל היו בכלל העמדה והערכה - אחד קדשי מזבח שנפל בהם מום, ואחד קדשי בדק הבית:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:2:3.english: Everything was included in [the requirement of] standing and valuation - Both [animals] consecrated for the altar that developed a blemish, and [items] consecrated for Temple upkeep:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:2:4.hebrew: האמר - במתני' (לקמן חולין דף פה.): "השוחט ונמצאת טריפה, חייב לכסות", אלמא שחיטה שאינה ראויה שמה שחיטה:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:2:4.english: Doesn't he say - In the Mishnah (below, Chullin 85a): "[If] one slaughters [an animal or bird] and it is found to be a tereifah [an animal with a fatal defect], he is obligated to cover [its blood]." Thus we see [that according to Rabbi Meir], a slaughter that is not fit [to permit the meat] is [nevertheless] considered [halakhic] slaughter:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:3:1.hebrew: ר"ש - סבירא ליה התם: קדשי מזבח בכלל העמדה והערכה, קדשי בדק הבית לא היו:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:3:1.english: Rabbi Shimon - he holds there: sacrifices consecrated for the altar [are] included in [the requirement of] standing and valuation, [whereas] items consecrated for Temple maintenance were not:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:4:1.hebrew: רבי היא - מתניתין, רבי סתמה לפי דעתו, ונסיב מילתיה כי הני תרי תנאי, בחדא כמר, שראה דבריו של זה בזו ושל זה בזו:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:4:1.english: It is Rabbi - [As for] our Mishnah, Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] stated it anonymously according to his own view, and he took his statement in accordance with these two Tannaim, in one [matter] like one master [and in the other like the other], for he approved the words of this one in this [matter] and of that one in that [matter]:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:6:1.hebrew: והשתא דאתית להכי - דדרשינן כה"ג:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:6:1.english: And now that you have arrived at this - [meaning,] that we expound [the verse] in this manner:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:6:2.hebrew: אפילו תימא בקדשי מזבח - ודקאמרת ליגרריה וליכסייה, אמר קרא כו':
Rashi on Chullin 84a:6:2.english: You may even say [it refers to birds] consecrated for the altar - And [as for] what you said, "Let him scrape it [off] and cover it" — the verse says, etc.:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:7:1.hebrew: מה חיה - סתמא אינה קדש, שאינה ראויה להקריב:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:7:1.english: Just as an undomesticated animal - Ordinarily it is not consecrated, since it is not fit to be offered [as a sacrifice]:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:8:1.hebrew: אוציא תורים ובני יונה - מדין כסוי, ואפילו הן של חולין:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:8:1.english: I will exclude doves and pigeons - from the law of covering [the blood], even if they are non-sacred:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:8:2.hebrew: הואיל ויש במינן קדש - "אלא" לא גרסי':
Rashi on Chullin 84a:8:2.english: Since their species can be consecrated - We do not read [the word] "rather" [ella, before this phrase]:

Rashi on Chullin 84a:9:1.hebrew: לא חלקת בה - דכולן חייבות בכסוי, דהא אין בה קדושה:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:9:1.english: You did not differentiate in it - For all of them are obligated in covering [the blood], since there is no sanctity in it [an undomesticated animal].

Rashi on Chullin 84a:9:2.hebrew: אף עופות לא תחלוק בהם - לומר מין זה חייב ומין זה פטור, ומיהו חולין בעינן כחיה:
Rashi on Chullin 84a:9:2.english: So too, [with regard to] birds, you shall not differentiate among them - to say [that] this species is obligated [in covering the blood] and this species is exempt; however, we require [that it be] non-sacred, like an undomesticated animal:

Tosafot on Chullin 84a:1:1.hebrew: וליפרקינהו וליכסינהו - תימה, מנלן שצריך לפדותו ולחייבו בכסוי? ועוד, דמתניתין "ואין נוהג במוקדשין" קתני, ואי פריק להו, אין זה מוקדשין! וי"ל דהכי פריך: כיון שסופו לפדותו משום הפסד קדשים, לכשיפדה הוה למפרע שחיטה ראויה; א"כ, ליכסינהו ואפילו קודם פדייה! ועוד, דאית ליה לר"ש כל העומד לפדות כפדוי דמי, ואפילו לא יפדם לבסוף הויא שחיטה ראויה, משום שחיטת קדשים דהויא שחיטה ראויה לר"ש אפילו נשפך, משום דכל העומד לזרוק כזרוק דמי, כדאמרינן במרובה (ב"ק דף עו:):
Tosafot on Chullin 84a:1:1.english: And let one redeem them and cover [their blood] - This is astonishing: from where do we know that one must redeem it and obligate him in covering [the blood]? Furthermore, our Mishnah teaches, "and it does not apply to consecrated [animals]," and if he redeems them, this is not consecrated! One can answer that this is what [the Gemara] is asking: since it will ultimately be redeemed because of the loss of consecrated [property], when it is redeemed, it becomes retroactively a valid slaughter; if so, let him cover them even prior to redemption! And furthermore, Rabbi Shimon holds [that] anything that stands to be redeemed is considered as already redeemed, and even if he does not redeem them in the end, it is a valid slaughter — [learned] from the slaughter of consecrated [offerings], which is a valid slaughter according to Rabbi Shimon even if [the blood] spilled, because anything that stands to be sprinkled is considered as already sprinkled, as we say in [the chapter] Merubbah (Bava Kamma 76b):

Tosafot on Chullin 84a:1:2.hebrew: בעינן העמדה והערכה - וא"ת: והא כל זמן שמפרכסין בני העמדה והערכה נינהו, כדאמר לעיל בפרק ב' (חולין דף ל.): "וכ"ת בעינן העמדה והערכה, הא תנן: שחט בה שנים או רוב שנים ומפרכסת — הרי היא כחיה לכל דבריה"? ודוחק לומר דהכא איירי בעוף דאין בו חיות כל כך, דהכשרו בסימן אחד, דאין סברא לחלק. ומפרש ה"ר שמעיה, ד"שחט בה שנים או רוב שנים" היינו כדאמרינן בהעור והרוטב (לקמן חולין דף קכא.), דישראל בטמאה ועובד כוכבים בטהורה, כדפירש ר"ח לעיל בפ"ב (חולין דף ל.). והתם דוקא מפרכסת היא כחיה, דע"י שחיטה אינה ניתרת באכילה, והויא כחיה עד שתמות. וכן הא דקאמר התם בפ"ב: "מדמי פסח מי אידחו?", וחשובה מפרכסת כחיה — כשלא גמר שחיטה איירי, דבשחיטה פורתא לא משתריא באכילה; אבל הכא, דבשחיטה זו משתרי באכילה, לאו בני העמדה והערכה נינהו:
Tosafot on Chullin 84a:1:2.english: We require setting and valuating - And if you say: Behold, as long as they are convulsing, they are capable of setting and valuating, as [the Gemara] said above in the second chapter (Chullin 30a): "And if you say we require setting and valuating, behold we learned [in a Mishnah]: If one slaughtered in it two [organs] or the majority of two, and it is convulsing — behold, it is like a living [animal] for all its matters"? And it would be forced to say that here [the Gemara] is speaking of a bird, which does not have so much vitality since its fitness [for slaughter] is with one organ, for there is no logic to distinguish [between them]. And HaRav Rabbi Shemayah explains that "If one slaughtered in it two [organs] or the majority of two" refers to what we say in [the chapter] Ha'Or VeHaRotev (below, Chullin 121a), [concerning] a Jew [slaughtering] an impure [animal] or a non-Jew [slaughtering] a pure [animal], as Rabbeinu Ḥananel explained above in the second chapter (Chullin 30a). And there specifically, a convulsing [animal] is like a living [animal], because through [that] slaughter it does not become permitted for eating, and it is like a living [animal] until it dies. And similarly, that which [the Gemara] says there in the second chapter: "Are they rejected from [being used for] the blood of the Passover offering?" — where a convulsing [animal] is considered like a living [animal] — it is speaking of when one did not finish the slaughter, for with a slight slaughter it is not permitted for eating; however, here, where through this slaughter it becomes permitted for eating, they are not capable of setting and valuating:

Tosafot on Chullin 84a:21:1.hebrew: עשרה מנה יקח ליטרא דגים, נ' מנין יקח ליטרא בשר - במקומם היו דגים בזול יותר מן הבשר, כדפירש בקונטרס, אבל במדרש אומר: אורחים — יום ראשון אווזין ותרנגולים, יום ב' דגים, יום שלישי בשר, [רביעי] קטנית:
Tosafot on Chullin 84a:21:1.english: [One who has] ten maneh should purchase a litra of fish; fifty maneh, he should purchase a litra of meat - In their place fish were cheaper than meat, as Rashi explained; however, in the Midrash it says: [Regarding] guests — [on the] first day, geese and chickens; [on the] second day, fish; [on the] third day, meat; [on the fourth], legumes:

Tosafot on Chullin 84a:6:1.hebrew: יצא זה שמחוסר שפיכה גרירה וכיסוי - ולא דמי לדם הניתז (לקמן חולין דף פז:), דהתם אם לא היה ניתז לא היה צריך גרירה, אבל כאן אי אפשר בלא גרירה:
Tosafot on Chullin 84a:6:1.english: Excluded is this, which is lacking pouring, scraping, and covering - And [this] is not comparable to spurted blood (below, Chullin 87b), for there, if it had not spurted, it would not require scraping, whereas here it is impossible without scraping:

Tosafot on Chullin 84a:7:1.hebrew: מה חיה שאינה קדש - וא"ת: והא אפילו קדשים טעונים כסוי, דתנן בפרקין (לקמן חולין דף פה.) "קדשים בחוץ, רבי מאיר מחייב"? ויש לומר, דאינה קדש בפנים קאמר:
Tosafot on Chullin 84a:7:1.english: Just as an undomesticated animal that is not consecrated - And if you say: But even consecrated [birds] require covering [of the blood], as we learned in our chapter (below, Chullin 85a): "Consecrated [birds slaughtered] outside [the Temple] — Rabbi Meir obligates [covering their blood]"? One can say that [the Gemara] means [one] that is not consecrated [for offering] inside [the Temple]:
